contract: v16 C1-C9+C6a; v17 authorizes implementation without changing wire contract

boundaries.frame: Exactly one complete 4-byte big-endian-prefixed strict UTF8 JSON object.
boundaries.json: Body-only generic interpretation cases; operation fields intentionally not imposed.
boundaries.framing: Literal malformed/incomplete header or body; reject before interpretation.

roles.local-client: Local session/gateway request path; caller omits authenticated from. Results/events on same path are schema-validated before live mapping checks.
roles.gateway-forward: Authenticated routed forwarding path: send/state.get/state.list/interest.add/interest.remove, all requiring from.
roles.adapter-delivery: Gateway-to-Pi path: deliver plus authenticated state/interest requests. Receiver deliver result may only admit/reject, never claim unknown.
roles.remote-link: Authenticated inter-gateway path: own-machine discovery/unwatch, ping and authenticated routed operations. Machine/scope authorization belongs to live connection state.

encodedBounds: wire/*.hex is authoritative raw evidence; expected.value is canonical decoded data, not a generator. Descriptor bytes include its actual object representation including escaping/whitespace. Full frame cap counts the prefix.

semanticBoundaryCases.runtime: not_admitted invalid_correlation; runtime must compare exact replyTo sender/recipient with retained scoped evidence

semanticBoundaryCases.case: well-shaped receipt with wrong runtime/scope/message binding
semanticBoundaryCases.runtime: protocol failure for a live mapping; well-formed stale mappings discarded without allocation

semanticBoundaryCases.case: forged remote machine or unapproved scope claim
semanticBoundaryCases.structural: accepted if identifiers are syntactically valid
semanticBoundaryCases.runtime: connection machine binding and current directional policy must deny; no admission/wake

identity: Effective send key is sender PeerRef + recipient PeerRef + scopeId + message.id; rid is not an idempotency key. Decoded key order/escape spelling are irrelevant, but optional absence, array order and exact Unicode remain distinct. Retained receipts/expiry/atomic admission are adapter-owned, not implemented by the decoder.
